info.name: Flying Angels - Account roles and athlete permissions
info.description:
Secured-mode role verification, ordered for Postman desktop and Newman. Run 00 - Account setup and use-case checks, then 01 - All endpoints - role access matrix, then 02 - Cleanup and sign out. All 438 requests must remain selected for a complete run. Setup creates numeric athlete/meet/event IDs; missing fixture IDs stop the run before invalid URLs are sent. Invites and activates Coach/Athlete accounts through local Mailpit, checks all 84 endpoints under four identities, shared note writes and private-note protection.

Invitations are queued durably. Mailpit search steps poll for asynchronous delivery; configurable mailPollAttempts (default 40) and mailPollDelayMs (default 500) bound the wait.
